nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
events {
}

http {
    include conf.d/*.conf;
}
# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/cert-inline.conf:
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name cert-inline.example.com;
    ssl_certificate ssl/split-a.crt;
    include snippets/split-a-key.conf;
}
# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/key-inline.conf:
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    server_name key-inline.example.com;
    include snippets/split-b-cert.conf;
    ssl_certificate_key ssl/split-b.key;
}
# configuration file /etc/nginx/snippets/split-a-key.conf:
ssl_certificate_key ssl/split-a.key;
# configuration file /etc/nginx/snippets/split-b-cert.conf:
ssl_certificate ssl/split-b.crt;
